name: forest-kit
subject: The copied forest kit loads, stands the player on its baked ground, walks 50 m and measures every view

resources.allowTrivial: Measured synchronous scene enter; baked scatter must not run in enter.
The drawn lake centre must match the baked [x,z] basin. The value stays at 1 when no lake is drawn, so an absent lake fails too.
The character settles during warmup; grounded must still hold after the walk and scene transition.
Maximum measured error is a held upper bound; contactSamples separately requires fresh observations during the scenario.
The asymmetric triangle fixture runs once after physics startup; its observed difference qualifies the sampling method.
A steady-state bound on what is drawn, not a transition: the props are placed on the first physics step, which the warmup frames already cover, so the count holds before and after by construction.

A ceiling on the prop draws, which holds for every frame rather than changing at one: its value is the price of the instancing, and a run that only ever saw it once would prove nothing. 64 since the layered understorey (bush, fern, litter species at one draw each); every view CPU p50 stayed within 4 ms at 63 draws (v11 licensed). Measured and reported, never capped: the owner removed the CPU/draw budgets so the starter worlds can carry Gaia-level density (2026-10-02).
A floor on the geometry actually submitted, which holds for every frame for the same reason as the instance count.

The widest gap between two detail levels' own base Y in one prepared variant, measured on the geometry that is actually drawn. A level authored off the ground draws a crown floating above a neighbour that stands correctly, and grounding cannot fix it because grounding measures the trunk the levels share. Zero on a machine with no prepared art, which is why this is a ceiling and not a floor.

Detail levels carrying no bark or stone part at all. A cutout-only level is a crown with nothing holding it up, which is the same defect seen from the other side; the far cross-card is exempt because its trunk is baked into its own pixels. Fails closed on a prep that drops a trunk, which no diff shows and every capture does.

Frame cost at the meadow framing, the nearest look at the trees. A real measurement needs at least one closed budget window at that view; zero means the window never closed while it was on screen. Measured and reported, never capped: the owner removed the CPU/draw budgets so the starter worlds can carry Gaia-level density (2026-10-02).

Frame cost at the overview framing, where the far impostor band carries most of the forest. Zero means no window closed at that view. Measured and reported, never capped: the owner removed the CPU/draw budgets so the starter worlds can carry Gaia-level density (2026-10-02).
Triangles submitted at the meadow framing. A floor on real geometry, so a run that reported zero could not be the picture the trees are judged in.
Triangles submitted at the overview framing, where the LOD bands are supposed to have replaced most of the near geometry.
Measured and reported, never capped: the owner removed the CPU/draw budgets so the starter worlds can carry Gaia-level density (2026-10-02).
Measured and reported, never capped: the owner removed the CPU/draw budgets so the starter worlds can carry Gaia-level density (2026-10-02).

Maximum measured CPU p50 across every visited camera; measuredViewCount separately requires all 17 poses to close budget windows. Measured and reported, never capped: the owner removed the CPU/draw budgets so the starter worlds can carry Gaia-level density (2026-10-02).

Presented-interval p95 of the slowest view, measured and reported but not capped: the runner's private Xvfb is not a real display, so a frame rate from it is wrong, not missing (packages/playtest/AGENTS.md). The 60 fps verdict comes from `playtest perf` on a real display.

A closed CPU budget window at every captured view must be observed and remain within 4 ms; missing or zero observations fail. Measured and reported, never capped: the owner removed the CPU/draw budgets so the starter worlds can carry Gaia-level density (2026-10-02).
Counts the actual baked nonzero transport observations; absent or empty maps fail.
Counts actual hydraulic deposition samples from each played heightfield.
Long Tasks must actually be observed; unavailable is not zero.
Longest actual main-thread task after the first frame, across loading and play; presentation waits are excluded.
Warm launch to the complete prop tier, not framework readiness before assets land.
Worst per-view median timestamp-query GPU cost, valid under Xvfb; this is not a displayed-fps claim.
Every forest view closed a measured window.
Every forest view closed a GPU-timed window.
The walk step drives the player 50 m across the forest.
Rock and trunk bodies resident around the player.

components.allowTrivial: Measured gap between all 1024 continuation seam vertices and their playable baked samples.
Every perimeter vertex must be observed, including all four corners.
Scripted cameras hide only the rendering mesh; ground contacts and travel still exercise its physics body.
